about.title: About Nordic Runes
about.heading: About Nordic Runes
about.runesDesc1: Runes are ancient alphabetic symbols used by Germanic and Norse peoples dating back to around the 2nd century. The Elder Futhark consists of 24 runes, each with its own meaning, history, and spiritual significance.
about.runesDesc2: Beyond their use as a written alphabet, runes have been used for divination and spiritual guidance for centuries. Each rune carries layers of meaning—from practical to metaphorical—and can be interpreted based on whether it appears upright or reversed.
about.elderDesc: The 24 runes of the Elder Futhark are divided into three groups of eight, called "Aettir" (families):
about.firstAettDesc: Fehu through Wunjo - Associated with fertility, creation, and physical manifestation.
about.secondAettDesc: Hagalaz through Sowilo - Associated with challenge, transformation, and trials.
about.thirdAettDesc: Tiwaz through Dagaz - Associated with self-realization, growth, and completion.
about.step1Desc: Navigate to "Draw Runes" and choose how many stones to draw (1, 2, or 3).
about.step1Sub: You can select a predefined category (Love, Career, Health, etc.) or ask a custom question.
about.step2Desc: The app will draw the runes and provide a comprehensive interpretation.
about.step2Sub: Each reading includes guidance for moving forward and context specific to your question.
about.step3Desc: Visit the "Runes Reference" page to study all 24 runes in depth.
about.step3Sub: Each rune card shows both upright and reversed meanings, guidance points, and full descriptions.
about.step4Desc: Save readings and add your personal reflections.
about.step4Sub: Build a record of your spiritual journey over time.
about.singleRuneDesc: A focused reading providing a direct answer or perspective on your question. Best for quick guidance or daily inspiration.
about.twoRuneDesc: Shows the current situation and potential outcome. Reveals how your present circumstances may evolve and what influences are at play.
about.threeRuneDesc: Explores the past influence, present situation, and future guidance. Provides the most comprehensive perspective on your journey and what lies ahead.
about.uprightDesc: An upright rune represents the direct, positive, or active expression of its energy. It often indicates flow, clarity, and alignment with the natural progression of the situation.
about.reversedDesc: A reversed rune suggests challenges, blockages, shadow aspects, or the need to reconsider your approach. It's not necessarily negative—rather, it invites reflection and adjustment.
about.disclaimer: This application is designed for personal reflection, entertainment, and spiritual exploration. Rune readings are not a substitute for professional advice, medical guidance, or professional counseling. Use these insights as a tool for self-reflection and as one perspective among many when making important decisions.

help.title: Help & Guidance
help.heading: Help & FAQ
help.q1: What does it mean when a rune is reversed?
help.a1: A reversed rune doesn't mean something is 'bad'—it suggests challenges, blockages, or shadow aspects that need attention. It invites reflection and adjustment rather than indicating a negative outcome. Think of it as the rune showing you what needs to change or be reconsidered.
help.q2: How many runes should I draw?
help.a2: It depends on your question and how much detail you want. A single rune gives a focused answer or daily guidance. Two runes show the current situation and potential outcome. Three runes provide the most comprehensive view with past influence, present situation, and future guidance.
help.a3: Yes! You can use the predefined categories (Love, Career, Health, Finance, Personal Growth, or General) or ask a custom question. The reading will be tailored to whatever you ask, so be specific and thoughtful about your question.
help.a4: Rune readings are tools for reflection and self-exploration, not predictions of the future. They work best when you approach them with openness and use the guidance to gain perspective on your situation. The real value comes from what you learn about yourself through interpreting the runes.
help.a5: Yes! On the reading page, you can add your personal reflections and click 'Save Reading.' All your saved readings are stored locally on your device. You can view them anytime in the Reading History section.
help.a6: The Elder Futhark is a set of 24 ancient runes used by Germanic and Norse peoples. Each rune has its own symbol, name, and meaning. Together they represent different aspects of life—from material prosperity to spiritual transformation. Visit the About page to learn more.
help.q7: How often should I consult the runes?
help.a7: There's no set frequency. Some people draw daily for inspiration, while others consult runes when facing a specific question or decision. The best approach is whatever feels right for you—listen to your intuition about when to seek guidance.
help.q8: Where is my reading history stored?
help.a8: Your reading history is stored locally on your device using your browser's local storage. This means your readings stay private and aren't sent to any server. If you clear your browser data, your readings may be deleted, so be mindful of this.
help.q9: Can I export or print my readings?
help.a9: You can view all your saved readings in the Reading History section and take screenshots if you want to keep a record. The reading details are easily viewable and can be photographed or copied as needed.
help.q10: Is this a substitute for professional advice?
help.a10: No. Rune readings are for spiritual exploration and personal reflection only. If you're facing important decisions about health, finances, relationships, or legal matters, please consult with qualified professionals. Use rune readings as one perspective among many, not as your sole source of guidance.
